content.text: Line 226 is the culprit (should be `=== null`).

candidates.explanation: The branch `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }` treats an omitted photo as an explicit request to clear it. When the profile page sends only the first name, photo is undefined, so photo is set to null. The mapper turns null into a null photo relation, and that is persisted, so the avatar is removed. Other fields such as email use `=== null` to clear, and this branch should do the same.

fix.description: Change the condition to `updateUserDto.photo === null`, so that only an explicit null clears the photo and an omitted photo stays undefined (unchanged).
